business_problem: KLab needed a more scalable and cost-efficient infrastructure for a globally distributed mobile game whose growing concurrency and operational spend were constraining expansion and complicating migration from the existing environment.
solution_summary: KLab migrated the production environment for its game workload onto Alibaba Cloud in the US (Virginia) region and rebuilt the serving path around cloud-native traffic management and governance. Global Accelerator brings users to the closest edge, Application Load Balancer handles HTTPS termination and smart path routing, and a HAProxy layer on Elastic Compute Service performs detailed request routing before traffic reaches microservices on Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK). Persistent data is stored in ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL running in serverless mode and accelerated with Tair as the high-speed cache. Static content is kept in Object Storage Service and delivered globally through Alibaba Cloud CDN, while Cloud Governance Center adds AI-driven cost visibility and optimization across the estate. This design helped KLab preserve operational continuity during migration, lower technical overhead with automated resource management, and create a game platform that can handle large bursts of player traffic without carrying the same idle-cost burden.
business_outcome: KLab reduced infrastructure cost pressure, maintained stable global gameplay, and reinvested savings into game development and player-experience improvements.
architecture_clues: Production environment runs in the US (Virginia) region
HAProxy on ECS performs detailed routing before ACK microservices
RDS for PostgreSQL runs in serverless mode
OSS lifecycle rules tier infrequently accessed assets to IA or Archive

solution_components.name: Global Accelerator
solution_components.role: Brings players into the platform with low-latency edge routing.

solution_components.name: Application Load Balancer
solution_components.role: Terminates HTTPS and routes game traffic to the correct backend services.

solution_components.name: Elastic Compute Service
solution_components.role: Hosts the HAProxy routing layer and supporting compute workloads.

solution_components.name: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK)
solution_components.role: Runs the microservices that power game features behind the front-end edge path.

solution_components.name: ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL
solution_components.role: Stores persistent application data for the game services in serverless mode.

solution_components.name: Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible)
solution_components.role: Acts as the high-speed cache for latency-sensitive game operations.

solution_components.name: Object Storage Service
solution_components.role: Stores static assets and offloads cold data through lifecycle management.

solution_components.name: Alibaba Cloud CDN
solution_components.role: Delivers static content to players worldwide with low latency.

solution_components.name: Cloud Governance Center
solution_components.role: Provides AI-driven cost governance and optimization across the environment.

data_flow: Player traffic enters through Global Accelerator and ALB, is routed by HAProxy on ECS to ACK microservices, persists core state in PostgreSQL and Tair, and serves static assets from OSS through Alibaba Cloud CDN while Cloud Governance Center monitors efficiency.
